top_concerns: No baseline ML experiments or reference results, so the claim of standardized, fair benchmarking is unsupported
Claimed benefit of correlated sampling shown only by distribution illustration, not by effect on model performance or comparison with OPFData
Realism of sampling/time series is weakly validated (uniform scale plus iid noise, spline-interpolated hourly data, no renewable variability, possible temporal leakage in the random split)
Data quality under-documented (feasibility rates, local-optimality of Ipopt AC solutions, all-formulation feasibility filter bias)
Evaluation metrics given as prose recommendations without operational definitions or tooling; narrow scope (linear cost, only demand varies, single-element N-1)
